// RefreshTokenCookie: Locally the Angular dev server proxies /api, so the cookie is same-site. SameSite=None would be rejected over plain HTTP.
// Cors: The Aspire-assigned port for the Angular client. Requests through the dev-server proxy are same-origin and need no entry; this covers direct calls.
// Database: Migrate on start-up locally so a fresh clone has a working database after one run.
// Seed: Passwords come from AppHost user secrets; see README. Without them the accounts are skipped and you can still register.
